title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Purpose Of Role**
To administer and support HR technology platforms, ensure smooth system operations, maintain data accuracy, enable users, and improve HR processes through effective configuration, testing, reporting, and troubleshooting.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Core System Administration & Configuration

uKnowva HRMS: Handle day-to-day administration, module setups (Onboarding, Attendance, Leave, Performance Management), resolve user tickets, and maintain accurate employee master data.
  
  
Phenom (Talent CRM): Manage candidate pipeline workflows, optimize career site landing pages, set up nurture email campaigns, and configure automated chatbot pathways for applicants.
  
  
Otomeyt Testing: Coordinate pre-employment assessment setups, assign technical and behavioral tests to candidates based on role requisitions, monitor test delivery, and troubleshoot technical glitches.
  
  
Qualtrics EX: Configure, test, and launch employee lifecycle surveys (Onboarding, Pulse, Annual Engagement, Exit), manage distribution lists, and format raw survey output for analysis.
  
  
Tableau Dashboards: Refresh, update, and build routine operational HR reports and basic interactive dashboards in Tableau to track metrics like time-to-hire, attrition, and survey response rates.
  
  

* Testing & Quality Assurance (QA)

Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for all software updates, patches, workflow tweaks, and system integrations across uKnowva, Phenom, Otomeyt, and Qualtrics.
  
  
Test API integrations and data syncing between platforms to identify data drops, field mapping errors, or latency issues before live rollout.
  
  

* Operational Support & End-User Enablement

Act as the First Point of Contact (Tier 1 & Tier 2 support) for employees, recruiters, and managers facing access issues or platform bugs.
  
  
Create and update User Guides, SOPs, and short video walkthroughs to train new hires and HR team members on system utilization.
  
  
Manage vendor support tickets (Phenom, Otomeyt, uKnowva, Qualtrics), tracking them through resolution within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  
  

* Data Governance & Reporting

Perform routine data audits across platforms to ensure data integrity, field consistency, and compliance with data privacy standards.
  
  
Extract cross-platform reports to support monthly and quarterly HR business reviews.
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Functional / Technical**
HRMS Platform Administration (uKnowva, Phenom, Otomeyt, Qualtrics EX)
  
  
System Configuration, Role Management & Bulk Data Uploads
  
  
Advanced Excel, Basic SQL & Data Validation
  
  
UAT Testing, Bug Tracking & Resolution
  
  
Basic Understanding of APIs, Webhooks & SSO
  
  
Tableau Reporting & Dashboard Creation
  
  
**Behavioural**
Strong attention to detail
  
  
Problem-solving & root cause analysis
  
  
Customer service orientation
  
  
Adaptability & quick learning ability
  
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Sales Executive | CRM | Help Desk
description:
**Company Description**
SHRIJI EXBIZ PVT. LTD. is an Anand, Gujarat–based manufacturer and global supplier of customized, high-performance enzyme solutions. The company serves multiple industries, including food processing, feed, textile, detergent, leather, brewing, paper & pulp, and wastewater treatment. Its products are designed to improve process efficiency, product quality, and sustainability for clients worldwide. Team members work in a science-driven, customer-focused environment where innovation and practical application are both valued. The organization offers opportunities to collaborate with diverse industries and contribute to sustainable solutions.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Executive | CRM | Help Desk role based in Anand. The role involves managing the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and qualification to proposal development, negotiation, and order closure across relevant industry segments. The Sales Executive will maintain and update CRM records, track opportunities, and ensure timely follow-ups, while providing responsive help desk support to customers via phone, email, and other channels. Daily responsibilities include handling customer inquiries, coordinating with technical and operations teams, preparing sales reports and forecasts, and supporting after-sales service to ensure customer satisfaction. The role also requires identifying new business opportunities, participating in product presentations or demos, and contributing feedback from customers to improve products and services.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Sales and customer relationship skills, including lead generation, account management, negotiation, and customer support.
* CRM and help desk capabilities, such as maintaining accurate customer records, managing tickets, tracking interactions, and ensuring timely resolution.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Basic understanding of industrial or chemical products; experience with enzymes or related sectors (food, textile, detergent, etc.) is an advantage.
* Proficiency in common office and productivity tools, including spreadsheets, CRM software, and email platforms.
* Ability to work on-site in Anand, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and manage multiple priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related field preferred; relevant sales experience in B2B or industrial markets is beneficial.
* Strong problem-solving mindset, customer-focused attitude, and willingness to learn about new processes and applications.

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.

description:
**Job Summary** 




  





 IT Support Lead Engineer acts as
 **Level 3 support staff in the IT SD Support escalation matrix** 
 . As a lead engineer, you should have a solid technical background with Microsoft products, ticketing systems, security products like AV, DLP, Firewall, patch management. A problem\-solving attitude with an ability to train new hire and existing staff, can document troubleshooting and training KB articles, coaches’ team on technical issues. Can co\-ordinate with different cross functional team members, vendors for escalated issue resolution.

 1\. Act as L3 escalation point for unresolved cases and come up with a technical way ahead for challenging and unsolved IT SD Support cases.

 3\. Trains new hires with IT SD technical training program.

 9\. Excellent customer Service Skills, Excellent problem\-solving skills.

 12\. Customer\-centric
 



 13\. Problem Solver
 



 14\. Critical thinker
 



 15\. Can work under pressure
 



 16\. Multi\-tasking.
